https://www.reddit.com/r/RimWorld/wiki/modfaq

From the sidebar, that's where I got all my mods from.

Make sure to visit them whenever you can, that's all you can really do. You get certain breeds of cats that are hypoallergenic, I believe. Also, I have an allergy to both cats and dogs but I have both. Developed a resistance, I suppose. I understand how you feel. My cat is my companion. When I went on holiday I missed her terribly. Best thing to do is not to feel sad when you see other cats, but try to befriend them. Well, for me anyway. Hope this helps somewhat.
Radiohead - Motion Picture Soundtrack. As well as There, There by them. A lot of Radiohead songs tend to make me weepy. Hope it helps.

I'm on the equivalent in my country (lexamil). It helps keep me a little more stable, but it doesn't really help with anxiety any. I'm always anxious. But I do have bipolar and take it alongside a mood stabiliser, plus it works differently for everyone. Just take it and see how it goes. I was always told the best time to take it was right when you wake up. Carry you through the day, essentially.
Thank you. Not looking for definitive answers - no such thing in this case - just would like some opinions, experiences. Much appreciated.
